cycle_4_8w.summary: UNAVAILABLE cycle direction and UNAVAILABLE action posture: longer-window observations are ready, but they do not establish a stable phase or a supported forward cycle path.

strategic_21_30d.expected_path: First test whether BTC stabilizes after the late decline; then whether ETH/BTC and short-window breadth stop weakening; finally assess whether longer-window participation and settled ETH flows improve. No cycle transition is scheduled.
falsification: Sustained BTC and ETH recovery together with stronger ETH/BTC, persistent broader participation and improved settled ETH flows would weaken the downside-sensitive base case.
A failed BTC stabilization alongside continued ETH-relative weakness and shrinking breadth would weaken the mixed base case toward contraction.
A single rebound or isolated short-window breadth reading does not establish broad rotation.

scenarios.label: BASE
scenarios.thesis: Stabilization attempts alternate with retests; ETH remains relatively weak and broad rotation stays unconfirmed.

scenarios.label: BULL
scenarios.thesis: Price resilience becomes durable while ETH-relative strength, participation and settled ETH flows improve together.

scenarios.label: BEAR
scenarios.thesis: BTC stabilization fails and ETH-relative weakness and breadth deterioration persist.

strategic_21_30d.summary: The 21–30-day outlook is MIXED: BTC MIXED, ETH DOWN and ETH/BTC DOWN; WAIT posture, low confidence and a MIXED destination. Scenario weights are uncalibrated, not probabilities.

12h.path: Current-state continuation unless the native confirmation or deterioration gate changes state.

168h.path: MIXED with downside retest risk: rebounds from W42 lows show resilience, but ETH-relative weakness, fading alt breadth and net outflows limit recovery confirmation.

72h.path: Short-horizon state is cross-checked against the current weekly regime; transmission must improve before risk moves down-cap.
